info.title: Beyond Spacetime physical-process and remote synchronization calculations
info.description: Read-only synthetic model predictions. Candidate rates are stipulated; this API does not establish a physical universal time or feasible travel.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Omit model and all parameters to retrieve model definitions.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Common reference interval (hours); only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height difference (m); only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Relative speed (m/s); only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: alpha_a
parameters.description: Transition A gravity response; only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: eta_a
parameters.description: Transition A motion response; only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: alpha_b
parameters.description: Transition B gravity response; only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: eta_b
parameters.description: Transition B motion response; only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: alpha_decay
parameters.description: Decay gravity response; only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: eta_decay
parameters.description: Decay motion response; only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: half_life
parameters.description: Reference half-life (hours); only valid for model rates.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: True remote clock offset (s); only valid for model synchronization.

parameters.name: outbound
parameters.description: Outbound signal delay (s); only valid for model synchronization.

parameters.name: return
parameters.description: Return signal delay (s); only valid for model synchronization.

parameters.name: turnaround
parameters.description: Remote turnaround (s); only valid for model synchronization.

parameters.name: deadline
parameters.description: Home deadline after first transmission (s); only valid for model synchronization.

200.description: Deterministic numerical result or model definitions
